feat: enhance development setup for dev.mcc-cal.com with auto-start options and deployment guide

- Updated README.md to include three ways to start the development environment: auto-start with VS Code, manual with VS Code tasks, and command line script.
- Added new script `start-dev.sh` to streamline starting both Next.js server and Cloudflare tunnel.
- Introduced new npm script `dev:full` in package.json to run the new start script.
- Updated deployment guide with detailed steps for Cloudflare Tunnel, Vercel, and Cloudflare Pages deployment options.
- Updated subproject commit reference in src/api.
- Cleaned up unnecessary files and added new logs for better debugging.
